subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick 20-minute demo & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jmiles@dataforge.io>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick 20-minute demo & next steps

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood — welcome! I wanted to send a quick note with a couple of options to get you into a short technical demo so we can:

- Walk through the hosted API and Dedicated options that fit your latency needs
- Show the Console for cost/latency breakdowns and rollout controls
- Answer any security/compliance questions up front

If a 20-minute intro works, pick any slot that fits your team here: https://calendly.com/redwood/20min (or reply with preferred windows and we’ll coordinate).

If helpful, here’s a one-pager and a short agenda I’ll cover on the call: demo-agenda.pdf, redwood-quickstart-onepager.pdf (attached).

Looking forward — feel free to CC anyone from your team who should join.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Jordan Miles <jmiles@dataforge.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — quick 20-minute demo & next steps

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the quick touch. I’m interested but traveling today and the Calendly slots are all Pacific business hours. Two quick asks:

1) Could we do something early ET next week (Mon/Tue morning ET)? I’m on the product team and would like the platform-level overview plus how you handle high-throughput batching.
2) Please include Morgan Li (morgan@devstack.ai), our infra lead, on the invite.

Also — are any of the attachments a short SLA summary? My procurement person will want to see that later.

Cheers,
Jordan
Jordan Miles
Product Manager, DataForge
jmiles@dataforge.io

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jmiles@dataforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — quick 20-minute demo & next steps

Hi Jordan — Monica here from Redwood (looping Karthik back in). Thanks for the note and safe travels.

We can absolutely do early ET next week. I pulled a couple of options:
- Mon 2028-04-24 09:00 AM ET / 06:00 AM PT (20m)
- Tue 2028-04-25 09:30 AM ET / 06:30 AM PT (20m)
- Tue 2028-04-25 11:00 AM ET / 08:00 AM PT (30m, if you want a deeper walkthrough)

Pick whichever works best and I’ll send a calendar invite. If none of those fit, propose two windows and I’ll match. You can also use this direct booking link (same as Karthik’s): https://calendly.com/redwood/20min

For procurement: attaching a short SLA summary and a one-pager that covers billing and regions — see "redwood-quickstart-onepager.pdf" and "demo-agenda.pdf" attached. If your procurement team needs the full compliance pack (SOC 2 evidence, data retention), I can drop a link to our security portal in the follow-up.

Attendees on our side will be: Monica Patel (Solutions Engineer) and Ben Carter (Sales Engineering) — Ben is CC’d. Please confirm any other internal attendees, and whether you prefer a 20- or 30-minute window.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Miles <jmiles@dataforge.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Morgan Li <morgan@devstack.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 09:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — quick 20-minute demo & next steps

Monica — thanks, Tue 2028-04-25 09:30 AM ET works for us (20 minutes is fine). I’ve added Morgan to this thread.

We’ll expect a quick run through on: throughput/latency tradeoffs, autoscaling behavior, and any constraints around private VPC deployments. If you could drop the compliance portal link in the invite or follow-up, that’d be great — procurement will want to triage that before the deeper eval.

See you Tuesday — please send the calendar invite when you can.

Jordan
